diagnosis.confirmed_mechanism: The pinned synchronous transport request retains the Python GIL. Subscription callbacks require it. A long request can cover the bounded simulation and leave an immediate observer snapshot empty while an independent process observes advancing simulation.
diagnosis.retrospective_limit: Historical failures did not record receipt/control timestamps; their exact reply/dispatch interleaving cannot be recovered. This mechanism reproduces their paused-only snapshot signature; it does not prove packet loss or service rejection.
